scope: Exploratory rotating whole-drive tests; the primary Mong Kok result was already inspected. Not an untouched final benchmark.
selection_basis: Each acquisition is tested once; source and validation roles follow a fixed cycle, without searching permutations or thresholds on test.
aggregation: Equal-weight mean across the three test drives; report individual test counts/availability. Distinct drives, not three cities, and not independent retrain repetitions.
